These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

recOq9xeYHvqku9Dl.Bio: LC King is a recurring InnerVerse "Vibe Rant" panelist who brings a mechanical/engineering background to discussions of electric-universe theory, cavitation technology, and the intersections of astrology and alchemy.
recOq9xeYHvqku9Dl.Name: LC King

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Gabe Presented an Alphabet Zodiac Cipher", "body": "Gabe presented a new cipher that started the alphabet at the spring equinox and wrapped it around the zodiac. He said the layout produced a birth cycle just under nine months, and he argued that layering familiar standards revealed information hidden in plain sight, which he called steganography. He pointed to the letters G and H as the symbol for Mercury, tied their 7 and 8 to the 78 cards of a tarot deck, and said three times 78 gave 234, which he linked to the axial tilt of the Earth. He suspected Francis Bacon had done something similar."}, {"title": "Mario on Symbolic Studies and Hidden Symbols", "body": "Mario described Symbolic Studies as a project that decoded each astrological sign through its glyph and mythology, growing out of art he began illustrating about three years earlier. When asked whether certain groups keep their symbols obscured, Mario answered that they might instead be putting symbols in plain sight while the meaning stayed hidden, and he compared it to how many people wear crosses without understanding them. After someone asked for a professional Mario level graphic of the cipher, Mario agreed to design one, and Chance showed his print catalog near the end."}, {"title": "LC King Found 27 in the Luminaries", "body": "LC King argued that the sun, moon and planets were interlinked rather than separate, and that multiples of 27 revealed the connection. He said he shifted the decimal on the lunar cycle and used 108 to land near the synodic month, within roughly 0.2 percent. He added planetary figures to reach 364 days, seven planets and 52 weeks, and said Saturn appeared as the mean of the luminaries. He also questioned whether the year was really 365 days, and described a battery model of the world."}, {"title": "Ophiuchus and the Central Pole Sign", "body": "Gabe described his Ophiuchus discovery, saying the letters O, P and Q outlined the serpent bearer, R, S and T marked a resting point between the lunar 18 and solar 19, and T, U and V reduced to 234. He said Ophiuchus rested a foot on the W, the only three syllable letter, and noted that Hebrew tav means foot. He recalled David Matheson suggesting the figure could stand for the higher self. The conversation then compared Ophiuchus to a thirteenth sign at the hub of the zodiac wheel."}, {"title": "Gabe on Yom Kippur and the Kepri Circle", "body": "Gabe argued that his cipher encoded the Yom Kippur ritual. He described the Kepri beetle rolling a sphere and said the word scribe came from scarab. He drew a line across the circle for the two goats of equal value, rearranged ABC into cabra for the goat that stayed in the temple, and counted ten stations to the letter Z for the scapegoat. He said the missing pie wedge of the cipher stood for the cliff. Gabe also tied Az to the Hebrew word for goat and to Azazel."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Slick Dissident’s new cipher reveals amazing correspondences and Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies), and LC King bring their vast knowledge to bear. So much alpha-numeric mysticism and re-centering from Solar to Polar, it’s astounding.
